name: Virginia
overview: Virginia authorizes local elderly/disability real-estate relief and mandates a disabled-veteran exemption.

programs.name: Local elderly and disabled real-estate exemption/deferral
programs.ageRule: 65 or older, or permanently and totally disabled if local ordinance includes disability.
programs.incomeDefinition: If a locality sets an income limit, the cited statute counts preceding-year income of owners who use the dwelling as their principal residence and relatives who live there, except bona fide caregivers. Localities may include resident nonrelatives except bona fide tenants or caregivers. Localities may exclude disability income of permanently and totally disabled resident relatives or nonrelatives, and other specified income sources or portions. The inventory does not establish the effective-date history for every 2025 application.
programs.maximumBenefit: Local ordinance determines exempted taxes, deferral, or combination.
programs.formulaSummary: Localities may exempt taxes, defer them, or limit increases; relief is not uniform statewide.
programs.application: Apply to local commissioner of revenue or designated official.
eligibilityNotes: Ownership interests and jointly owned property affect proration.
programs.programYear: 2025 locally adopted property-tax relief, using preceding-year income under the local ordinance.

sources.title: Virginia Code: local elderly and disability real-estate relief

programs.name: Disabled Veteran Real Property Tax Exemption
programs.ageRule: Qualifying disabled veteran or unremarried surviving spouse.
programs.maximumBenefit: Qualifying principal dwelling and up to one acre of land exempt from real-property tax. More land qualifies where the locality's Article 2 relief covers a larger area. Land the veteran does not own does not qualify.
programs.formulaSummary: Mandatory exemption for a veteran rated 100% service-connected, permanently and totally disabled by the VA; proration may apply with other owners.
programs.programYear: 2025 real-property tax exemption on the qualifying principal residence.

programs.name: Real estate tax itemized deduction
programs.incomeDefinition: Federal income rules affect the itemized deduction.
programs.incomeLimits: Income rules affect larger itemized deductions.
programs.maximumBenefit: Claim the qualified amount within the applicable itemized deduction limits.
programs.formulaSummary: Include qualified real estate taxes in Virginia itemized deductions. Virginia adds back amounts the federal SALT dollar limit disallows, subject to its overall itemized deductions limitation.
programs.application: Claim on Virginia Schedule A if you itemize on your federal return.
eligibilityNotes: Use qualified real estate taxes for the applicable form.
interactions: The overall Virginia itemized deductions limitation can apply at higher income. Virginia follows your federal choice to itemize.
